q2_gaps: a proper noun whose whole name IS its own kind word ("the Council", "the Watch"): the multi-word-name rule requires the entity's kind in one ordinary type atom beside the Name fact, but here that atom would be the degenerate (Member council council), and no alternative is given

a recurring indicative conditional whose antecedent is a STATE rather than an event ("If the moon is full, the Council meets ..."): the occurrence-quantifying form indexes the consequent event to a trigger variable, but a variable-free premise leaves no binding to index on, and the instruction set never expands its own plain-Implication conditional example to atoms, so the consequent event's form (constant vs occurrence-indexed) is unsettled
notes: The definite moon's typing correctly projects outside the rule, Location (not LocatedIn) is right for the event's "at", the capitalized Council/Watch correctly get name-derived symbols with one Name fact each, and a singular collective subject rightly gets one Agent with no distribution rule.
